run_fast_mcd: run the fast_mcd function to estimate the Minimum Covariance Determinant matrix from data
create_mincovdet: create a MinCovDet estimator and fit it to a dataset for robust covariance estimation
test_c_step: test the c_step procedure to iteratively compute MCD location and covariance estimates
select_candidates: select the best candidate subsets of observations for computing robust MCD estimates
summarize_correct_covariance: summarize the MinCovDet.correct_covariance method to apply consistency correction to raw MCD estimates
refactor_reweight_covariance: refactor the MinCovDet.reweight_covariance method to reweight estimates by excluding outlying observations
